default_domain_name.description: The default domain name to assign to DHCP clients.

default_domain_name_servers.description: List of DNS resolver addresses to assign by default.

default_lease_time.description: Default lease duration (in seconds) for dynamic addresses.

max_lease_time.description: Maximum allowed lease duration (in seconds). Clients cannot exceed this.

enable_forwarders.description: Enable DNS forwarding; if true, DHCP server forwards queries to listed upstream servers.

forwarders.description: List of upstream DNS server IP addresses (used only if forwarders are enabled).

networks.description: List of IPv4 subnets to serve. Each subnet defines address range, optional static mappings, and options.

netmask.description: IPv4 netmask (e.g., '255.255.255.0' or CIDR suffix '24' — though dhcpd expects full mask).

range_start.description: First address in the dynamic pool (e.g., '192.168.1.100').

range_end.description: Last address in the dynamic pool (e.g., '192.168.1.200').

default_gateway.description: Optional gateway/router address for clients in this subnet.

broadcast_address.description: Optional broadcast address (defaults to subnet broadcast if omitted).

subnet_mask.description: Optional override for subnet mask; usually match netmask.

ntp_servers.description: Optional list of NTP server addresses.

dns_servers.description: Optional list of DNS server addresses (overrides default).

hosts.description: Optional list of static DHCP reservations within this subnet.

hostname.description: DNS hostname to assign to the client.

standalone_hosts.description: List of static host entries not tied to a specific subnet. Useful for infrastructure devices.

ip.description: Fixed IP address for this host.
